title: Online Joint Replan Under Finite PSS Admission
base_evidence: FR-P9-007 same-surface hosted joint residency/concurrency proxy
question: Can a joint residency/concurrency plan remain bound to planner-relevant resource and measurement certificates and replan only when those facts change?

resource_transition.transition_type: synthetic admission-cap change over hosted measurement anchors

hard_invariants: observation epoch alone does not invalidate a plan
resource certificate mismatch rejects stale plan
measurement certificate mismatch rejects stale evidence binding
job semantics remain identical across replan
resource feasibility does not grant execution authority
resource replan does not grant retry permission
next_falsifier: replace synthetic admission-cap transition with an isolated physical pressure domain or quota and compare observed replans with certificate predictions
